name: ariadnev-web
description: Public web surface for ariadnev: Astro marketing site, static Fumadocs documentation, and the release edge Worker.

scripts.test:native: node --test tests/contracts/public-edge-contract.test.mjs landing-consistency.test.mjs scripts/edge-ingress-rule.test.mjs scripts/legacy-host-redirect.test.mjs workers/edge/src/index.test.mjs workers/edge/src/github-app-auth.test.mjs workers/bridge/src/index.test.mjs tests/deployment/deployment-control-plane.test.mjs tests/deployment/compose-deployment-input.test.mjs tests/deployment/probe-public-edge.test.mjs tests/tokens/token-contract.test.mjs tests/tokens/font-contract.test.mjs tests/tokens/generated-css.test.mjs && pnpm run test:docs
scripts.test:qualification: pnpm --filter @ariadnev-web/contracts run build && pnpm run docs:content && pnpm run contracts && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:visual
scripts.test:visual: playwright test --project=chromium && playwright test --project=firefox tests/visual/journeys/ && playwright test --project=webkit tests/visual/journeys/
